$comment: THE SUMMARY GROUPINGS (REQUIREMENTS #636, owner 2026-10-19: "summary could be build as views with the detailed data instead. it is just views with groupings of data instead, like group per tier category" / "community must switch" / "same core functionality"). ONE declarative definition of every Summary-shaped grouping of the Detailed findings, read by ONE engine function (engine/_shared/SI-SummaryGroupings.ps1 Invoke-SISummaryGrouping) in both editions: Pro -- the data sync writes the result per collection into sidata.SummaryGroup / SummaryGroupCounted / SummaryGroupState (the SQL the function compiles from this file); Community -- the same function groups the Detailed result in the run (no SQL) for its management mail and outputs. 'fields': the finding values a key or a measure reads -- 'sql' the sidata.Finding expression (alias f), 'row' the Detailed row's columns (the first one present wins), 'kind' how the value is normalised the same way on both paths (text: trimmed, '' for none, at most 'max' characters; tier: '0'..'3' or 'Unclassified'; tierNumber: 0..3 or none; severity: one word of 'severityWords' after lower-casing and removing spaces, '-' and '_' -- '' = 'None', any other word = 'Other'; id: a whole number, none = '0' (Unassigned); number: a decimal or none; flag: '1' when the value is true / 1, else '0'; presence: '1' when the value is set; tokens (#812): a ';'-list, every separator of 'split' turned into ';' first -- a finding counts once under each distinct trimmed token (at most 'max' characters), a tokens field is a grouping key only, one per grouping; band (#812): a number into the field's 'bands' (the first whose 'atLeast' / 'above' it meets), else 'else', no value = ''). 'pathRow' (tier, tierNumber): an attack-path row (its report starts Attack_Paths, or its Category starts AttackPath / is 'Attack Paths') takes that column when it has it -- the source asset's tier, as the data sync stores it (Get-SIDataRowTiers). 'measures': the same columns on every grouping (and on sidata.SummaryGroup): count (rows), countDistinct (distinct non-empty values of 'field'), max / min / sum (of a number), each optionally only over the rows 'where' a field equals a value. 'groupings': id, label (a person's name for it), keys (1-3 fields, in order -- Key1..Key3), labelField (the name shown next to the key: the most recent text in sort order, MAX), attributes (optional, owner 2026-10-20: the Summary report's columns per row -- 'max' / 'min' of a text or date field (the empty text / no date never wins), 'first' = the value earliest in 'order' (the most severe; a value outside it ranks after, the greatest of those), 'list' = the distinct non-empty values in ascending order, at most 'max' of them joined with '; ' -- stored per row as AttributesJson, a property per attribute, none = left out). A 'date' field (2026-10-20): the day 'yyyy-MM-dd' of a date, none = no value. 'exempted': the field whose presence leaves a row out of the counted variant (#264: SummaryGroupCounted / Counted = true). Changing anything here changes the definition hash: the data sync then writes every stored collection again (newest first). Add a grouping = one entry here (and its words in the web app's grouped view); add a measure = one entry here + its column in sql/si-data-schema.sql (a test holds the two together).

groupings.label: Per recommendation and tier (as the Summary report)
